subject: general
question: National Legal Service Day is celebrated on 9th November. NALSA came into force in which of the following year?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1995**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• National Legal Service Day came into force on 9th November **1995**.
 
• The Day is celebrated to make people aware of the various provisions under the **Legal Services Authorities Act and the right** of the litigants.
 
• It was first started by the **Supreme Court of India**.
 
• The day is observed to commemorate the enactment of the Legal Services Authorities Act and to create awareness about the various provisions related to the act.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Persons with disabilities have equal rights, and the government should make possible their full participation in society, the government has to provide **free education and integrate children with disabilities** into mainstream schools, this law was passed in** 1995**.
 
• **Aziz Mushabber Ahmadi** was the **26th Chief Justice** of India in **1995.**
 
• The Constitution **77th amendment Act, 1995** was introduced in the Lok Sabha on **May 31st, 1995**. This Act extended **reservations for promotion in employment for Scheduled Castes and Tribes** (SCs and STs).
